scope: One synthetic size-4 native ObjectStroke and host Mesa GLES Draw-target observation; same boundaries and limitations as the V25 size-8 control.
capture_boundaries: Host callbacks supplied the screen profile, identity color conversion, flags and version; native ObjectStroke setters supplied the synthetic input.

The harness directly wrote ObjectStroke obj+32 to attach its separately constructed implementation and SimpleBrush pen+8 to attach a constructed PenGLDataManager with a host queue. Emulated context, vtables, stubs, loader and runtime support were also host-provided; this is not an unmodified device execution.

A host queue explicitly ran the constructor-posted clipping task before SetClipRect, then dispatched a bounded prefix of retained native tasks. Renderer callbacks, EGL context and Mesa GLES were host boundaries, not natural device worker scheduling.

At the real host GLES instanced-draw callback the harness identified the native draw target, checked the already-current complete FBO, attachment, viewport and color mask, explicitly cleared the target to transparent black and verified an all-zero readback, restored observer-visible clear/scissor state, forwarded the draw once and read RGBA. The source capture used an all-zero synthetic canvas.

paint_observation.fragment_behavior: The captured shader emits vec4(inputColor.xyz, 1.0) multiplied by its smooth edge alpha; inputColor.a is unused.
paint_observation.readback: Raw host GLES glReadPixels RGBA; original receipt does not infer premultiplication.

crop.origin: OpenGL bottom-left, x=0..31, y=0..15, contiguous RGBA rows

provenance.limitations: The named scripts and original receipt are ephemeral, not retained by this compact receipt; helper scripts, binary inputs, adapter and host environment are also required. Hashes identify observed artifacts and do not establish a runnable reproduction.

geometry_comparison.result: Mismatch: coordinates and first 13 triples match, while the last four radii differ by one float32 ULP. The cause is unverified; size 4 remains outside the production profile. No paired SVG/PDF control has been established.
